definition: to wake someone after they faint
description: In a village hall decorated with bunting during a baking contest, a man in a green jumper lies dazed on his back across a table of pies and cakes. A young woman in a green cardigan and jeans kneels over him, wrinkling her nose, and holds an open box with a green herb pie right under his nose. He slowly opens his eyes and lifts his head, and she breaks into a delighted smile. A cook in a white hat gasps behind them, a crowd watches, and a cherry pie and a tipped jug of cream sit in front.

de.answer: Sie hält ihm eine Kräuterpastete unter die Nase.
de.question: Was macht die Frau?

es.answer: Le está poniendo un pastel de hierbas bajo la nariz.

fr.answer: Elle lui tient une tourte aux herbes sous le nez.
